setup.runtime: yue2-infer 0.1.3 wheel, torch 2.10.0+rocm7.1 (official pin), AMD Radeon PRO W7900D 48GB
setup.evaluator: frozen wsb_metrics + patches 0006/0007/0009/0010, metrics venv python 3.12.11, torch 2.10.0+rocm7.14.1 [device-gfx1100], ASR qwen_asr transformers backend, greedy, max_new_tokens 4096, 4 repeats, auto language

interpretation: The transformers-ASR evaluator scores official-range PER (6.5%) on good audio: the evaluator substitution is NOT a systematic 2x inflator.
W7900 generation reaches official-level vocal intelligibility for this prompt on BOTH the official PyTorch path and the SGLang path.
The r1 candidate's higher PER corresponds to genuinely mis-sung lyrics in the generated audio (transcript divergence is real generation variance, not scoring error).
The historical 17% aggregates are therefore tail-driven (88-128 capped ASR runs of 384, empty transcripts, weak candidates), not a uniform evaluator or hardware bias.
Agenda for the full campaigns: preserve complete per-song receipts to quantify the tail (capping, empty transcripts, per-language, per-duration).
